units.source_text: 匂皇子是今上与明石皇后所特别宠爱的人，世间声望也隆重无比。

en.t: Prince Niou was especially beloved by the reigning emperor and Empress Akashi, and his reputation in society was extraordinarily high.

units.source_text: 尤其是六条院诸人，因为他是由紫夫人抚育长大的，所以上上下下都把他看成家里的主君一样。

en.t: In particular, because the people of Rokujo-in knew he had been raised by Lady Murasaki, everyone from high to low regarded him as though he were the lord of their own household.

units.source_text: 今日在宇治山庄招待他，特备山乡风味的筵席，非常讲究。

en.t: Today, to entertain him at the Uji villa, they prepared an especially elaborate banquet with the flavors of the mountain village.

units.source_text: 又拿出棋子、双六、弹棋盘等玩物来，随心所好地过了一日。

en.t: They also brought out go stones, sugoroku, a flicking-board game, and other amusements, and spent the day as they pleased.

units.source_text: 匂皇子不习惯于旅行，觉得有些疲劳，深盼在此山庄息足数日。

en.t: Prince Niou was unaccustomed to travel and felt somewhat tired, so he earnestly wished to rest for several days at this mountain villa.

units.source_text: 他休息了一会之后，到了晚来，便命取出管弦来奏乐。

en.t: After resting for a while, when evening came, he ordered the instruments to be brought out and music to be played.
